group.title: Inspecting a sensor
group.passage:
F1: The temperature display on line three shows forty degrees, but the room doesn't feel warm. Should we stop production?
M1: Let's compare it with the handheld thermometer first. We replaced that wall sensor last week, and its cable may have come loose.
F1: The handheld unit reads twenty-two. That's within the normal range for the adhesive.
M1: Then production can continue while I inspect the connection. Please record both readings in the shift log so the next team understands the difference.
F1: All right. The maintenance contractor is scheduled to visit at two. Shall I ask him to bring a replacement sensor?
M1: Not yet. I want to rule out a loose connection before we order another part. I'll call you once I've checked it.
